name: winter_wheat

source.t_base_c: [AS] AquaCrop wheat default, recalled from the reference manual (not re-read this session).
source.t_upper_c: [AS] AquaCrop wheat default upper threshold, recalled (not re-read this session).

source.stages: [AS] cumulative development units (thermal time above 0 degC, scaled by the vernalisation factor before stem elongation) from sowing. Chosen so that a mid-October sowing in the Rhein-Main climate flowers in early-mid June and ripens in July, as German winter wheat does (DWD phenology: heading late May, yellow ripeness mid-late July; recalled, not re-read). BBCH codes are the standard scale.

source.t_min_c: [AS] cardinal temperatures of the Wang & Engel (1998) vernalisation response for wheat as used by Streck et al. (2003), recalled from memory.
source.days_saturation: [AS] effective vernalisation days for the full development rate of a winter wheat; the literature spans roughly 30-60 days.
source.min_rate_factor: [AS] relative development rate of an unvernalised winter wheat before stem elongation.

source.cc0_cm2_per_plant: [AS] AquaCrop wheat default canopy size per seedling, recalled.
source.plant_density_per_ha: [AS] established plants in German practice (250-400 seeds per m2 drilled, roughly 80 % emerging).
source.ccx: [AS] AquaCrop wheat default maximum canopy cover, recalled.
source.cgc_per_gdd: [AS] inside the 0.004-0.007 per GDD range that winter-wheat AquaCrop studies report as recommended (Agronomy 11, 2265, 2021); the point value is chosen here.
source.cdc_per_gdd: [AS] same source and range as cgc_per_gdd (0.004-0.007).
source.senescence_acceleration: [AS] extra senescence progress per unit of senescence stress (1 - Ks_sen).

source.kc_tr_x: [AS] AquaCrop crop transpiration coefficient at full canopy, 1.10 for wheat, recalled.
source.height_max_m: [AS] FAO-56 Table 12 wheat height 1 m, recalled.
source.p_depletion: [C] FAO-56 Table 22 (Allen et al. 1998, ch. 8): winter wheat p = 0.55 at ETc ~ 5 mm/day, maximum root depth 1.5-1.8 m.
source.p_adjust_for_etc: [C] FAO-56 Table 22 note: p = p_table + 0.04 (5 - ETc), limited to 0.1-0.8 (the limits are in the code as the note's own range).
source.exp_p_upper: [AS] AquaCrop wheat canopy-expansion stress threshold, recalled.
source.exp_p_lower: [AS] AquaCrop wheat canopy-expansion stress limit, recalled.
source.sen_p_upper: [AS] AquaCrop wheat early-senescence stress threshold, recalled.

source.wp_star_g_m2: [AS] AquaCrop normalised biomass water productivity of C3 crops, 15 g/m2 (Steduto et al. 2007; Raes et al. 2012), recalled.
source.gdd_full: [AS] growing degree days per day at which biomass production is unrestricted by cold (AquaCrop 'minimum GDD for full biomass'), recalled.

source.hi0: [AS] reference harvest index; AquaCrop winter-wheat studies report 0.42-0.48.
source.hi_build_gdd: [AS] harvest index builds up over about 700 GDD after flowering.
source.pollination_window_gdd: [AS] development units after flowering whose stress counts for the harvest index.
source.hi_water_stress_k: [AS] harvest index loss per unit mean (1 - Ks_sto) during the window. FITTED: 0.2 left the simulated yield response milder than FAO-33 winter wheat (seasonal Ky 1.00, FAO table at fao.org/4/y3655e/y3655e04.htm) by up to 0.12 in relative yield; 0.4 brings the worst deviation over 45 season runs to 0.097 (test C10). The value is calibrated against that reference, so C10 guards the calibration; it is not an independent check.
source.heat_pollination_lo_c: [AS] Tmax at which heat starts to fail pollination.
source.heat_pollination_up_c: [AS] Tmax at which pollination fails completely.

source.zr_min_m: [AS] AquaCrop wheat minimum effective rooting depth, recalled.
source.zr_max_m: [C] FAO-56 Table 22: winter wheat maximum rooting depth 1.5-1.8 m (lower end).
source.gdd_full: [AS] development units from sowing at which the maximum depth is reached (before flowering).

source.kill_onset_c: [AS] daily minimum air temperature at which frost starts to kill an emerged stand; hardened winter wheat survives about -15 to -20 degC (LT50), literature range, not tuned.
source.kill_full_c: [AS] daily minimum at which the whole stand is killed.
source.snow_insulation_swe_mm: [AS] snow water equivalent above which snow shields the stand.
source.snow_floor_c: [AS] lowest temperature the stand sees under that snow.

source.harvest_window_days: [AS] days after maturity before the grain starts to shed.
source.shed_rate_per_day: [AS] fraction of the remaining grain lost per day afterwards.

source: F1a winter wheat. Most AquaCrop defaults are recalled from the reference manual and published calibrations, not re-read in this session, and are tagged [AS] on purpose; only values read this session are tagged [C].
